route: Work permit (Ministry of Labour, Department of Alien Employment; Labour Act 2017, art. 46(3))

permit.applies: The foreign worker (the alien) applies to the Ministry of Labour, on the employing institution's letterhead application
permit.first: A contract document and the employer's registration, tax and trade licences, with a CID clearance and Interpol certificate

sources.title: Ministry of Labour (South Sudan), Work Permit Applications: Requisite Procedures for Processing Work Permits
sources.said: It is issued by the National Ministry of Labor (Department of Alien Employment). Procedures for processing a work permit are as follow:- Alien should apply to the ministry for issuance of work permit An application form is issued for the alien to fill (cost of application) form is $ 100. … Institution /Business Letter head application … Contract Document CID Clearance Certificate Interpol Certificate … a payment voucher is produced for the alien to pay the required work permit fee to the prescribed bank account for non-oil revenue … a work permit smart card is issued to the alien with a validity of one year from the date of issuance.

sources.title: Eye Radio, Labour ministry orders crackdown on illegal foreign employment (December 2025); rests on the Ministry of Labour's circular of 4 December 2025
sources.said: The Ministry cited Article 46(3) of the Labour Act 2017, which mandates that all foreign employees in South Sudan must possess an approved work permit.

blockers.sought: the work permit fee itself (only the $100 form is priced; the permit fee is paid on a voucher)
